# 10X Shop

> 10X Shop is an educational React storefront that uses live DummyJSON catalog data and simulates shopping without payments.

Products can be browsed, searched, filtered and sorted in the storefront. The demo account, cart and saved orders are browser-local; checkout does not take payment or fulfill orders. The storefront does not provide an AI agent or tool API.

## Storefront

- [Product catalog](https://10x-shop-pavlepritula.vercel.app/): Search, filter and browse the product collection.
- [Example product](https://10x-shop-pavlepritula.vercel.app/products/5): View product details, stock, prices and reviews.
